$comment: Chat-path import-graph contract (docs/plans/oss-chat-m4-runtime-separation-plan.md section 5). Paths are relative to the OSS root; platform paths carry a plat: prefix. `chat` is the gated entry set (add the post-M2 turn modules and the agent-runtime entries as they land); `m4-measure` is the before/after receipt set. `allow` entries need a reason each.

closure.$comment: Closure mode (--closure). The M4 runtime file set lives in runtime-file-set.txt next to this file (the harness reads a set only through --closure @file); run `node scripts/testing/import-graph.mjs --closure @scripts/testing/runtime-file-set.txt`. `allow` is the explicit contract allowlist; `allowReasons` gives the reason for each entry and the files it admits today.

allowReasons.packages/shared/src/index.ts: @use-brian/shared is a declared dependency of @use-brian/agent-runtime (plan section 2), and shared imports nothing from core or api. Six runtime files use the root: HostObservation (engine/query-loop-ports.ts, engine/turn-ledger.ts), HomeAppToolSet (tools/types.ts), homeAppToolRequirements (tools/capability-gate.ts), and FEED_IMAGE_CAPABILITY and feedImageCost (providers/gemini-image.ts, providers/codex-app-server/image.ts).
allowReasons.packages/shared/src/model-registry.ts: The same declared dependency. Twelve runtime files use it: registryRow and the model rows drive cost tracking (billing/cost-tracker.ts), token budgets (providers/context-budget.ts, engine/query-loop.ts), routing and the provider adapters.
